project.title: A girl named Maya and her small friendly robot Bolt find...
project.idea: A girl named Maya and her small friendly robot Bolt find a lost kitten in the rain and bring it home. Warm, gentle, storybook feel.

lines.text: Nobody believed a tiny robot could help in the rain.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then Bolt found a shivering kitten.
lines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Kitten in the rain
scenes.visual: Maya in a yellow raincoat and her small round robot Bolt crouch beside a garden hedge on a rainy evening, finding a tiny wet kitten shivering under a leaf. Maya's eyes are wide and soft.

lines.text: By bedtime, it was purring. Bolt even made it a bed.
lines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Warm at home
scenes.visual: Inside a cozy kitchen with warm lamplight, the kitten sleeps in a towel on Maya's lap while Bolt gently glows beside her. Rain streaks the window behind them.

cast.name: Maya
cast.description: A young girl about nine years old with a slight build, shoulder-length dark brown hair tied in a loose ponytail, and a bright yellow raincoat. Her wide, soft eyes and freckled cheeks make her easy to recognise.
cast.voice_note: Warm, gentle and curious, around nine years old, medium pitch, speaking softly with wonder and affection.

cast.name: Bolt
cast.description: A small, round, friendly robot about the size of a cantaloupe, with a smooth rounded body, a single glowing blue light as its face, and two little stubby arms. Its soft glow makes it easy to recognise.
cast.voice_note: Bright, cheerful and simple, a small childlike mechanical pitch, speaking in short, clear, earnest phrases.

shots.line: Bolt, nobody thinks a little robot can help in this rain.
shots.setting: Rainy evening in a garden beside a green hedge, dim blue-grey light with wet leaves. Maya wears her bright yellow raincoat with her dark brown hair in a loose ponytail. Bolt, the small round robot with a glowing blue light face, glows softly beside her.
shots.description: Medium shot of Maya in her yellow raincoat crouching beside a garden hedge in the rain, with Bolt glowing blue next to her. She looks down at Bolt with wide, soft eyes.

shots.setting: Rainy evening in a garden beside a green hedge, dim blue-grey light with wet leaves. Maya wears her bright yellow raincoat with her dark brown hair in a loose ponytail. Bolt, the small round robot with a glowing blue light face, glows softly beside her.
shots.description: Close shot of a tiny wet kitten shivering under a large leaf at the base of the hedge, while Bolt's blue glow lights it and Maya's yellow sleeve reaches in gently.

shots.line: Listen, it's purring. Good job, Bolt.
shots.setting: Cozy kitchen at night with warm golden lamplight, rain streaking the window behind. Maya still wears her yellow raincoat with her ponytail, seated with a small kitten asleep in a towel on her lap. Bolt glows softly blue beside her.
shots.description: Medium shot in a warm kitchen: Maya sits with the sleeping kitten in a towel on her lap, smiling down at it, while Bolt glows beside her and rain streaks the window behind.
